title: Virtual Assistant
description:

We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

title: Senior Trader, SeatGeek IQ
description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.
SeatGeek IQ works alongside major sports and entertainment rightsholders to build and run a collaborative pricing and inventory strategy, operating as an extension of their commercial teams and accountable to the same outcomes they are. The Senior Trader is the senior owner on a subset of our largest partnerships: the pricing calls, the inventory position, and the relationship with the people on the other side of them. Reporting to Kevin Shelton, Director of SeatGeek IQ, they work across live pricing, inventory strategy, partner management, and research, and help build what the team offers next. The team leans hard on automation and AI to keep analytical overhead off traders' plates, so the job stays about judgment rather than assembly.
At this level, you're accountable for the commercial health of the relationship, not just the pricing execution. That means owning renewal posture and escalations and being the person a partner's leadership calls first. You'll also be a pricing reference point for traders earlier in their careers, reviewing their work on high-stakes events and setting the standard for how the team operates.
What you'll do

• Serve as senior owner on a set of our largest sports and entertainment partnerships, setting pricing strategy with each partner, defending it, and revising it as the market moves

• Own the commercial health of those relationships, including renewal posture, escalations, and regular engagement with partner leadership

• Set and move prices across the event lifecycle, from presale through day-of, against sell-through targets, price realization, and spoilage risk

• Decide what inventory to hold, what to release, how to distribute it across channels, and when a position needs to be worked down rather than defended

• Manage the ongoing partner relationship through weekly and event-level reporting, regular strategy check-ins, and candid conversations when the market disagrees with the plan

• Mentor traders earlier in their careers and review their pricing work on high-stakes events

• Answer partner research questions on marketplace behavior, demand drivers, and season or event projections, then turn one-off requests into repeatable outputs the whole team can run

• Spot gaps in what we offer, such as services partners keep asking for, manual workflows that should be automated, or places AI tooling could sharpen a call, and lead pilots and builds of the solutions, including shaping our internal pricing and market intelligence products

• Close the loop after events with analysis of what pricing decisions actually produced, and carry it into the next cycle

• Travel roughly 20% of the year or more, concentrated in season and carrying a larger share of the team's on-site load, for partner site visits and business reviews, live events alongside partner teams (including evenings and weekends), industry conferences, and team offsites

What you have

• Bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, statistics, sports management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• 5+ years of experience in ticket pricing, revenue management, trading, or a comparable analytical commercial role, including at least 2 years as the owner of client or partner relationships, preferably in sports, live entertainment, or another dynamic-pricing industry

• Real sports knowledge: you understand how standings, schedules, rivalries, star players, and playoff races move demand, and can talk shop credibly with people who've worked in sports their whole careers.

• Genuine awareness of live entertainment, including how touring, on-sales, and routing shape demand

title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning
description:
At Hive, we’re all about creating moments that matter and helping event marketers connect with their biggest fans. Our platform powers marketing for 1,500+ iconic events, festivals, venues, and promoters across North America. We help them grow their customer base and sell out shows using intelligent, automated, and personalized digital marketing tools.

Hive integrates with 25+ platforms (like Ticketmaster and Shopify) to provide rich customer data in real-time, enabling event marketers to engage their audiences with precision and impact.

What Data team at Hive looks like

Hive’s R&D Data team is responsible for how we store and query production data at scale. We aren’t focused on only BI or dashboards - we build the systems that power Hive’s products and make data accessible, reliable, and performant.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll play a vital role in evolving our data platform, which directly determines what our customers can do, how fast our product moves, and how confidently leadership can make bets. You'll own outcomes, not tickets. If a business metric is off and it touches data, that's yours to care about.

What you’ll get up to

- Build our Data Platform: Design and own a cloud-native big data platform handling audience data for millions of attendees and billions of interactions a year. You're not just building pipelines - you're building the infrastructure that determines the quality of every insight, recommendation, and decision Hive's customers make.

- Build our ML Platform: Design and own the infrastructure that takes models from experiment to production - feature stores, training pipelines, model serving, and monitoring. You switch hats between data engineering and ML engineering, ensuring reliable, low-latency access to the features and infrastructure we need to build and ship models confidently. When a model degrades in production, you're the one who built the observability to catch it before the customer does.

- Own the Full Pipeline - and Its Business Impact: From Change Data Capture through validation, transformation, and denormalization - you drive the stack end to end. But you also understand what breaks for a customer when a pipeline is late, a metric drifts, or a model gets stale data. You connect the technical dots to the business dots.

- Treat Data as a Product: You don't ship pipelines - you ship data products that internal teams and customers depend on like a production API. You define SLAs, obsess over data health, build for discoverability.

- Build and Leverage Agentic Systems: You bring an agentic engineering mindset to everything - both how you work and what you build. You use AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as a force multiplier. And you build LLM-powered pipelines and autonomous agents that enrich, classify, and act on audience data at scale.

Our Tech Stack

- Programming: Python and Django

- Data Stores: Clickhouse, MySQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Redshift

- Orchestration: Airflow or Dagster

What you bring

- 8+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed data and ML systems in production - high-throughput event streams, real SLAs, and real consequences when things fail.

- Core ML foundations (supervised/unsupervised, cross-validation, bias-variance, regularization, eval metrics) and common algorithms (regression, tree ensembles, clustering).

- Feature engineering with Python ML tooling (pandas, scikit-learn; familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow).

- Production ML pipelines and feature datasets feeding model training and inference.

- MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning/registry, deployment, and monitoring for drift/data quality.

- Strong foundations in distributed systems principles - partitioning strategies, consistency models, backpressure handling, fault tolerance, and capacity planning at 10x the volume you designed for.

- Experience applying LLMs and agenti

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

The Driving Core team develops the learning methods that turn diverse driving data into robust closed-loop behavior. You'll be a technical owner for reinforcement learning within the group, working closely with researchers and engineers across AV Core, Simulation, Evaluation, and Product Engineering. Success means producing measurable improvements in driving behavior.

The Core Model Safety team develops the core model competencies that enable safe, driverless operation. In this team, you'll lead the technical direction and delivery of a learned emergency trajectory model for low-frequency, high-consequence manoeuvres such as evasive steering and emergency braking, taking the programme from problem definition through modelling, evaluation, integration, and evidence for deployment.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Senior / Staff Machine Learning Engineer in Wayve's AV Core organisation, you will advance reinforcement learning methods for end-to-end driving models. You'll identify where learning from reward or feedback can improve beyond behavior cloning, then take promising ideas from design through large-scale experiments, rigorous evaluation, and integration into our best driving models.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Shape and execute the reinforcement learning roadmap for Driving Core / Core Model Safety, selecting problems and methods against clear behavioral gaps and measurable success criteria.

- Help improve the reward models and related learning signals used to train and evaluate driving policies, working with partner teams to strengthen their quality, scalability, and downstream usefulness.

- Build robust training and experimentation workflows using large-scale driving data; diagnose distribution shift, objective misspecification, optimization instability, and data or evaluation bias.

- Define evidence across offline metrics, open-loop tests, closed-loop simulation, and on-road evaluation, and distinguish genuine policy improvement from benchmark overfitting.

- Productionize successful methods in the shared ML stack, communicate decisions and results clearly, and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

- You have a strong track record developing and experimentally validating reinforcement learning or closely related sequential decision-making methods on complex, high-dimensional problems.

- You have a deep understanding of modern reinforcement learning fundamentals, including policy and value learning, off-policy learning, function approximation, distribution shift, and the failure modes of learned objectives.

- You have hands-on experience with behaviour cloning, reinforcement learning, or related methods.

- You're proficient in Python and PyTorch, with strong software engineering practices and hands-on experience building reliable machine learning training and evaluation systems.

- You have excellent experimental judgement: able to turn an ambiguous behavioral problem into falsifiable hypotheses, useful metrics, disciplined ablations, and clear technical decisions.

- You bring senior-level ownership and collaboration: able to lead a substantial technical area, work across research and engineering boundaries, and bring others along through clear written and verbal communication.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (UK & Germany)
description:

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

INTERNATIONAL LEGAL COUNSEL (UK & GERMANY)

*German and England & Wales qualification to practice law required.

The Role

This is a newly created position within Multiverse’s Legal team, reporting directly to the General Counsel. As we expand our international footprint, this role is vital in establishing our in-house legal capability across both the UK and German markets.

You will serve as the primary legal partner for our German operations-including StackFuel GmbH and future acquisitions-while providing commercial legal support to the UK business. We are looking for a collaborative professional who enjoys working across cultures and is excited to contribute to a growing, impact-driven organisation.

What You’ll Do

- German Operations: Act as the lead legal advisor for German group entities, providing guidance on commercial, employment, and corporate matters.

- Contract Management: Lead the German commercial contracting lifecycle (B2B, B2C, and B2G), drafting and negotiating agreements that help the business scale safely.

- Regulatory Guidance: Navigate the German regulatory landscape, including vocational training regulations (AZAV), providing practical advice to support business growth.

- Strategic Integration: Support post-acquisition workstreams, including contract migrations, governance alignment, and compliance harmonisation for European M&A transactions.

- Employment Law: Advise on German employment matters, including works council engagement and equity schemes.

- External Partnerships: Manage relationships with external German counsel to ensure high-quality, cost-effective support.

- UK & Cross-Border Support: Draft and negotiate UK commercial contracts (tech, data, and partnerships) and act as a strategic bridge between UK and German business functions.

What We Are Looking For

We recognise that excellence comes from a variety of backgrounds. If you meet the core requirements below and are passionate about the role, we encourage you to apply.

Core Requirements:

- Legal Qualification: Qualified to practice law in Germany.

- Jurisdictional Experience: A strong understanding of the German legal market and experience working within the UK legal environment (e.g., in-house, international firm, or UK-based role).

- Language Proficiency: Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken), with the ability to negotiate and draft legal documents in both languages.

- Commercial Law Foundation: Experience managing a variety of commercial contracts and regulatory matters.

Great to Have (but not required):

- Experience in M&A transactions or post-closing integration.

- Background in German employment law (works councils or incentive plans).

- Prior experience in an in-house environment, particularly within the tech or edtech sectors.

- Familiarity with UK commercial legal frameworks.

Skills & Attributes:

title: Support Services Analyst (Level 2)
description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions , we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

The Support Services Analyst (Level 2) ensures that all customer needs are promptly and professionally addressed by responding to customers’ requests, problems, questions, and concerns in a timely and accurate manner, while exercising the highest level of service and quality.

The Support Services Analyst (Level 2) is also responsible for contributing to the analysis of customer problems and requirements, the development of the solutions and workarounds, and for testing and configuring Noggin software to implement those solutions on behalf of customers.

This position will require providing coverage on Saturday and Sunday, with rest days during the Monday to Friday timeframe.

Job Description
# Customer Support

• 1.1 Provide accurate, timely and professional support to the customer’s satisfaction using phone, email, portal, forums, and chat tools.

• 1.2 Gather information about customer problems and needs and analyze to help determine the cause.

• 1.3 Contribute to the knowledge about a customer to help with future support interactions.

• 1.4 Promptly resolve issues and questions meeting SLA requirements.

• 1.5 Confirm that technical workarounds and resolutions are satisfactory before asking the customer to confirm themselves.

• 1.6 Produce reports of customer support and system usage as required.

• 1.7 Act as the first point of escalation for the offshore team

• 1.8 Assist the offshore team to answer their questions related to the system, support processes and general best practices

# Product Knowledge

• 2.1 Proactively advance product knowledge to an expert level including self-education and experimentation with new product features, common tasks, and problems, and how these are applied or used within different solution settings.

• 2.2 Assist with maintaining Noggin’s knowledge base by contributing content and insights into common questions, and opportunities for improvement.

• 2.3 Share product feature requests and functionality gaps with internal teams to assist in defining the product roadmap and developing highly requested features.

# Internal Collaboration & Support

• 3.1 Be the customer advocate within Noggin and take responsibility for driving issue resolution and a shared understanding of the customer perspective.

• 3.2 Coordinate and collaborate with Noggin staff (DevOps, engineering etc.) to ensure SLA requirements are understood and met, and to help achieve the best solution.

• 3.3 Investigate issues, document your findings, and attempt to find a resolution before escalating to other teams.

• 3.4 Add value to internally escalated support tickets to include replication steps, links to relevant locations, and a conversion from the Customer’s terminology into Noggin terminology.

Basic Requirements
Qualifications & Experiences
The pre-requisite qualifications and experiences necessary for success in this job are:

• Bachelor’s degree in business / commerce / information technology / computer

• science, or equivalent qualifications or experience

• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in support services and analysis

• Experience in providing support to non-technical users of software

• Experience in software requirements or problem analysis

• Experience with modern service management practices and systems

Technical Capabilities

• Technically adept with support tools, including communication and support desk software (ticketing, self-service options, and customer support features).

You will work cross-functionally to establish clear plans, align teams, surface risks, and drive decisions.

- A track record of building repeatable systems and ways of working - not just executing within existing ones.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including experience delivering concise, decision-ready updates to executives and senior stakeholders.

- Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, complex customer implementations, migrations, or phased product rollouts is preferred.

title: Associate Support Engineer
description:
Associate Support Engineer

What we’re looking for
SMG is looking for an Associate Support Engineer to provide front-line operational and technical support across our products and services. You’ll help clients resolve everyday application, access, configuration, reporting, and troubleshooting needs while partnering with internal teams when issues require deeper expertise. This role is a strong fit for someone who combines technical curiosity, careful execution, and clear communication to keep client requests moving and deliver high-quality support experience.

What you’ll do

• Handle client requests through tickets and calls, resolving operational and technical issues while delivering a high-quality customer experience.

• Support day-to-day client needs including password resets, user access requests, standard configuration updates, basic reporting changes, and common troubleshooting requests.

• Use established documentation, tools, and troubleshooting steps to resolve routine application, configuration, and web-based issues.

• Gather complete diagnostic information for issues outside your scope and route them to the appropriate team to support efficient resolution.

• Follow up with clients and internal stakeholders on open requests, maintaining accurate ticket notes, documentation, and status updates.

• Perform quality control testing on support changes and client deliverables to confirm outputs are accurate and aligned to requirements.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to clarify business needs, support deliverables, and maintain alignment with product, process, and quality standards.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to documentation, templates, tools, and work processes while building knowledge of SMG products, tools, and technologies.

What success looks like

• Within 30 days, build working knowledge of SMG products, support tools, documentation, and standard processes, and begin resolving routine client requests with appropriate guidance.

• Within 60 days, independently manage a consistent volume of common support requests, document work accurately, and escalate more complex issues with complete diagnostic information.

• Within 90 days, deliver reliable front-line support across common client needs, contribute improvements that reduce repeat issues or increase efficiency, and participate effectively in required application support coverage.

Why you’ll love SMG

• We work with some of the world’s biggest and most valued brands.

• We’re fully remote, and we’re staying that way.

• We offer competitive compensation and benefits, which include but aren’t limited to:

• Unlimited PTO

• Extended parental leave

• Company-issued equipment and tools

• A culture built on connection, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What you’ll bring

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in technical customer support or service delivery.

• Experience supporting and troubleshooting applications or large-scale systems, including web-based applications.

• Working knowledge of application configuration, web-based platforms, support tools, and basic technical concepts such as HTML, SQL, data modeling, or system process design.

• Strong written and verbal communication, troubleshooting, prioritization, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and participate in application support coverage as business needs require.

Preferred:
• Experience supporting applications in a SaaS environment.
Who we are
SMG is an experience management (XM) partner to many of the world’s leading restaurant, retail, and consumer services brands.
With 30+ years of history under our belt, we pair an AI-native enterprise software platform with unmatched professional services to help organizations generate new revenue, grow existing revenue, reduce detractors, and drive operational efficiencies.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡YOUR MISSION: BUILD THE AGENT OPERATING SYSTEM FOR NURSES IN THE US

As Founding Product Manager, you’ll be our first product hire in the US and own what the US product is and how it scales. voize started as an AI voice scribe for nursing documentation and has grown into an intelligence operating layer that supports nurses and care leadership to improve care and outcomes. Today we’re live in 1 in 4 care homes in Germany, and with 5 pilots running in the US, your job is to turn them into a scaled business. You’ll report to the Head of Product, Markets, and work closely with our CEO and team in New York.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Shape the business. Decide with the CEO and GTM what we sell, to whom, and what the product has to prove first.

- Pioneer with nurses. Work alongside nurses onsite in hospitals and care homes. Learn from what carers do versus what the workflow says, and build a product they love.

- Build, test, repeat. Turn our first pilots into evidence: where nurses use voize without being pushed, where they don’t, and why. Form hypotheses about what users need versus what they say and validate them in real workflows.

- Ship what matters. Write sharp requirements, track honest metrics, and set up the data and feedback you need to make good calls.

- Make the hard calls on complexity. Decide with Engineering and ML what is reusable platform and what is truly US-specific. Work through EHR integration and compliance trade-offs.

title: Sales Account Executive: Data & Snowflake Services
description:
At Trifecta, we are more than just a technology company. We are a community of innovators, collaborators, and problem solvers dedicated to driving positive change in the world of technology. We are a dynamic organization that embraces diversity, fosters inclusion, and values the unique contributions of each of our Teammates. At Trifecta you will find a supportive and inclusive culture, endless opportunities for growth and development, and a vibrant community of passionate professionals dedicated to shaping the future.

We've been building and integrating enterprise systems for over 30 years. We're a Select Snowflake Partner with delivery practices across Snowflake, Salesforce, Salsify, AI, and custom development. Our consultants ship real work - that's what you'll be selling.

About The Role

As a Sales Account Executive, you'll own new business for our Snowflake and data services practice. You'll build pipeline, run complex sales cycles, and turn prospects into long-term clients.

Your best target list is companies that already own Snowflake. Budget is committed, and plenty of them stalled after the first migration - idle workloads, cost overruns, governance gaps, AI plans with no data foundation underneath. Your job is to find them, understand where they got stuck, and sell the work that unsticks them.

This role is for someone who generates their own pipeline, gets comfortable fast with technical buyers, and would rather scope a deal honestly than oversell it. As well someone who wants to continue to leverage their Snowflake experience.

What You'll Do

•
Prospect into the Snowflake install base. Find companies running Snowflake that aren't getting value from it. Outbound, referrals, Snowflake introductions - whatever gets you in the room. Qualify hard on where they're actually stuck.

•
Get wired into Snowflake's field org. Not just the AE. Their Customer Success teams see which accounts flatlined on consumption and are measured on fixing it - that's the same problem you're solving, so bring them a path. Same with their SEs, PS org, and partner managers. Know their quarter, know how they're paid, and make them look good.

•
Build your own top of funnel. Partner referrals are leverage, not a plan. You're expected to generate pipeline through disciplined outbound into target accounts.

•
Run full sales cycles. Discovery through negotiation and close. Multi-thread across the client's data, IT, and business leadership - and across Snowflake's team at the same time.

•
Scope honestly. You'll work directly with our delivery leads to size engagements. We'd rather lose a deal than sell something we can't deliver well. Our references are the reason we win the next one.

•
Sell consumption, not just projects. Frame engagements around the workloads they unlock and the platform spend they drive. That's how Snowflake evaluates partners, and how you get fed more deals.

•
Hit your number. Meet or exceed quota, keep the CRM current, and tell us what you're hearing in the market.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of B2B sales with a real outbound track record - self-sourced pipeline, not just closing marketing leads.

• Proven experience selling professional services on data and/or analytics projects. Scoped engagements, not software licenses.

• Experience selling to C-level and VP buyers across both IT and the business.

• Working knowledge of the modern data stack. You don't need to write SQL, but you should hold your own on warehouse compute and cost, migrations off legacy platforms (Redshift, Teradata, on-prem EDW), and where data projects go sideways.

• Solid foundational knowledge of how professional services engagements are sold and delivered.

• Ability to articulate a POV and value add of Snowflake and other data related services.

• Proficiency in CRM tools and running a disciplined pipeline.

• Ability to travel as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Existing relationships inside Snowflake's field organization - AE, SE, C

title: VP Quality and Accreditation
description:
The Vice President, Quality & Accreditation is the enterprise executive accountable for clinical quality performance across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial. This role owns HEDIS strategy and operations, accreditation (NCQA, URAC, and applicable state/federal standards), clinical quality programs, and the vendor ecosystem that supports HEDIS data collection, abstraction, and reporting.
This executive unifies quality functions historically siloed by line of business into a single operating model, ensuring consistent measurement, documentation, and improvement practices across Medicare and Commercial populations.
The role is accountable for HEDIS rates and audit results, accreditation status and survey outcomes, clinical quality program performance, and vendor ecosystem governance and cost.
Key Responsibilities:
Enterprise Quality Leadership & Operating Model
• Build a unified quality operating model across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial.
• Establish enterprise governance for clinical documentation integrity supporting quality measurement.
• Serve as the executive owner of enterprise HEDIS performance and accreditation status.
• Oversee all HEDIS operations, hybrid strategy, supplemental data, and provider documentation improvement, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Develop best-in-class intervention playbooks for each HEDIS measure.
Clinical Quality

• Lead enterprise clinical quality programs, including quality improvement initiatives, clinical practice guideline adoption, and provider quality performance programs.
• Ensure alignment with care management and population health functions on shared clinical priorities.
• Partner with COO, CFO, Network, Pharmacy, Stars, Risk Adjustment, and Operations leadership to ensure quality initiatives are coordinated enterprise-wide without assuming accountability for their respective programs.
Accreditation
• Own enterprise accreditation strategy and execution, including NCQA Health Plan Accreditation, URAC, and other applicable state and federal accreditation or certification requirements.
• Lead survey readiness, documentation, and corrective action planning for all accreditation activities.
• Maintain accreditation standards as they evolve and ensure organizational readiness for renewal cycles.
HEDIS Vendor Ecosystem Leadership
• Serve as the executive owner of the vendor ecosystem supporting HEDIS data collection, medical record retrieval, abstraction, and supplemental data.
• Consolidate and manage HEDIS vendors to reduce cost, improve data quality, and strengthen audit defensibility.
• Establish unified SLAs, KPIs, and performance governance for HEDIS-related vendors.
• Ensure vendors operate as extensions of the internal quality team.
Quality Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
• Ensure data quality, timeliness, and integration across clinical, operational, and vendor systems supporting quality measurement.
• In partnership with Health Services Analytics, build a unified reporting architecture for HEDIS, accreditation, and clinical quality programs.
Governance & Compliance
• Ensure compliance with NCQA, URAC, and applicable regulatory requirements governing quality and accreditation.
• Lead enterprise audit readiness for HEDIS and accreditation surveys.
• Establish governance structures for decision-making, escalation, and cross-functional alignment on quality matters.

Key Requirements:
• 10+ years of leadership experience in health plan Quality, HEDIS, and Accreditation, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.
• Proven track record of improving HEDIS rates and achieving strong NCQA/URAC accreditation outcomes.
• Deep knowledge of HEDIS technical specifications, NCQA accreditation standards, and clinical quality improvement methodology.
• Experience leading large cross-functional teams and complex vendor

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment.
You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required.

title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
¿Quiénes somos?
GomezLee Marketing es una empresa líder en Trade Marketing y ejecución en punto de venta en Centroamérica y el Caribe. Desde hace más de 30 años trabajamos junto a marcas globales de consumo masivo, ayudándoles a transformar su estrategia comercial en resultados visibles en tienda.

Objetivo del Rol
El rol tiene como objetivo ejecutar y operar de forma autónoma los proyectos de Business Intelligence dentro del framework de GLM Analytics, asegurando la correcta recolección, validación y análisis de la información, así como la generación de reportes, dashboards e insights accionables que impulsen la toma de decisiones estratégicas del negocio.

• Data Validation

• Data Analytics

• Data Advisor

• Levantar, estructurar y documentar requerimientos de negocio para el diseño de dashboards, modelos de datos e indicadores clave (KPIs).

• Extraer, transformar y validar información desde múltiples fuentes de datos (internas y externas).

• Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards, tableros de control e indicadores de gestión en herramientas BI.

• Detectar, analizar y resolver incidencias de datos de complejidad media, garantizando integridad y confiabilidad.

• Proponer mejoras en procesos de reportería y flujos de información, orientadas a estandarización, eficiencia y escalabilidad.

• Documentar procesos, reglas de negocio y flujos de datos asignados, asegurando trazabilidad y continuidad operativa.

• Apoyar en análisis exploratorios y generación de insights para equipos comerciales, operativos y estratégicos.

Licenciatura en Economía, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería de Sistemas, Administración, Mercadeo, Negocios Internacionales o carreras afines.
Experiencia

• Preferible mínimo 2 años en roles de Business Intelligence, analítica de datos o inteligencia comercial.

• Experiencia trabajando con múltiples fuentes de datos y generación de reportería ejecutiva.

Conocimientos Técnicos

• Dominio funcional de Excel avanzado (incluye Power Query y Power Pivot).

• Manejo de bases de datos relacionales (SQL / MySQL / BigQuery).

• Experiencia en Power BI.

• Deseable conocimiento en Tableau o Looker Studio.

• Capacidad para transformar datos en insights accionables orientados a negocio.

• Nivel de inglés avanzado.

Competencias Blandas

• Pensamiento analítico y estructurado.

• Autogestión y disciplina operativa.

• Organización y manejo de múltiples prioridades.

• Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de plazos.

• Comunicación efectiva con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.

• Criterio para la toma de decisiones basada en datos.

• Disposición al aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo profesional.

title: Senior Implementation Engineer - PACS / medical imaging systems
description:
Role Overview
The Senior PACS Implementation Engineer leads the build, integration, migration, and technical onboarding of customer environments onto the InSight PACS platform, acting as the technical expert for healthcare system commissioning and interoperability across NHS trusts, private healthcare providers, and third-party suppliers. The role is primarily hands-on and technical, with the successful candidate also coordinating the implementation team's day-to-day technical delivery and providing mentoring to less experienced engineers. Team leadership is a meaningful part of the role but remains secondary to its core focus on technical delivery.
Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end technical delivery of PACS build, integration, and migration projects, acting as the subject matter expert for DICOM, HL7, and healthcare interoperability standards across customer and partner environments.

• Design and troubleshoot integrations between PACS, RIS, EPR, VNA, and third-party clinical systems, translating customer workflows into effective, operationally sound technical solutions.

• Plan and execute imaging data migrations, including querying and troubleshooting the underlying databases, to ensure data quality and minimal disruption to clinical services.

• Lead day-to-day coordination of the implementation team's workload across build, integration, and migration activities, providing direct technical leadership, mentoring, and escalation support to engineers.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Client Experience teams to improve integration capabilities, maintain technical documentation, and support pre-sales and tender activities.

Required Qualifications and Experience

• 5+ years of experience implementing, integrating, or migrating PACS, RIS, VNA, or other healthcare imaging solutions.

• Strong working knowledge of DICOM services (C-Store, C-Find, C-Move, Modality Worklist) and practical experience with HL7 messaging in healthcare integration contexts.

• Strong SQL and database skills, including the ability to query, interrogate, and troubleshoot databases underpinning PACS and integration platforms.

• Direct experience with PACS build, configuration, and system commissioning within a regulated healthcare environment.

• Demonstrated experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring engineers within a technical delivery team.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

• Experience working with NHS organisations, including familiarity with NHS procurement processes and digital/information governance requirements.

• Knowledge of cloud-hosted healthcare applications and services.

• Experience with imaging archive consolidation or VNA migration programmes.

• Exposure to contributing to architectural standards or reference architectures (on-premises, hybrid, or cloud-based).

• Relevant project delivery, implementation, or healthcare IT certifications.

Travel Requirements - minimal, occasional visits to Basingstoke office for training & collaboration days

ABOUT THE ROLE

Applied Intuition's Digital Proving Grounds (DPGs) give the Department of War a vendor-neutral place to test autonomous systems from many companies together, against a real mission, before they reach the field. A DPG covers the full path from software-in-the-loop (SIL) simulation to hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), live-virtual-constructive (LVC), and live exercises. Teams find integration problems in simulation, where fixes take hours, instead of at a live event, where they take weeks.

DPGs run on Axion, Applied's defense toolchain, with Axion Sim at the core. Applied ran VREX for the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering, a DPG that put air, surface, and undersea vehicles from different vendors on one mission. CDAO then selected Applied to build the platform for Autonomy Factory, which brings this approach to programs across the Department of War on autonomy.mil http://autonomy.mil.

The technology works in programs. The next step is a product that program offices, test organizations, and mission engineers choose, adopt, and come back to, without Applied engineers supporting events. As the Product Manager for Digital Proving Grounds, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements for DPGs and Axion Sim. This is an individual-contributor role. You will work as the product peer to the engineering lead for Axion Sim and drive outcomes through influence across engineering, design, business development, and delivery.

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for DPGs and Axion Sim. Decide what becomes repeatable product and what stays program-specific work.

- Find product-market fit. Run discovery with program offices, test and evaluation organizations, mission engineers, and autonomy vendors. Learn who buys, what they need to prove, and what brings them back for the next event. Work with business development and capture to turn what you learn into offers that win programs.

- Define the sim-to-live workflow. Shape how a team goes from a mission and its concept of operations to test scenarios, then to SIL at scale, HIL rig checkout, LVC, and live events, with results that carry across each stage.

title: Senior Mobile Quality Engineer
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Own the mobile test strategy:

- Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

- Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

- Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

- Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

- Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

- Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

- Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

- Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

- Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

- Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

- Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.
